title: invisi-guard finding
description: One deterministic finding emitted by invisi_guard.scan(). Offsets (start, end) are Python str indices, i.e. Unicode code point offsets into the scanned text; end is exclusive. line and column are 1-based; column counts code points.

code.description: Stable rule identifier, e.g. IG-BIDI-OVERRIDE or IG-ZW-ENC.

severity.description: low = informational, medium = weird but not necessarily hostile, high = decodable payload or control sequence without a benign explanation.
